title: ViOCRVQA: Novel Benchmark Dataset and Vision Reader for Visual Question Answering by Understanding Vietnamese Text in Images
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for Vietnamese OCR-VQA. While 'Religion' is mentioned as one of the book genres in the dataset, the paper's focus is entirely on the technical task of text extraction and question answering accuracy (titles, authors, publishers), rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
